facts.fact: StackAdapt's Bulk Edit is associated with a 22% decrease in median session length compared to using the campaign editor (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: leveraging StackAdapt’s Bulk Edit is associated with a 22% decrease in median session length compared to using the campaign editor.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Bulk Edit tool lets users preview the campaigns or flights affected by a change before confirming the edits.
facts.quote: Bulk Edit useful because it will show you a preview of the edits on the flights you’ve selected, before you confirm the changes.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Bulk Edit Targeting option allows bulk addition or removal of geographic locations and audience segments across multiple campaigns.
facts.quote: to add or remove parameters such as geographic locations and audience segments based on campaign performance.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Bulk Edit Creative tab allows bulk upload of creatives and editing of them via a spreadsheet that works similarly to Excel.
facts.quote: the platform will allow you to edit the creatives using a spreadsheet that works similarly to an Excel spreadsheet.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Bulk Edit Bid and Goal tab allows changing flight dates, bid type and amount, goal type and amount, and budgets of multiple flights at once.
facts.quote: You can use the Bid and Goal tab to make adjustments to the flight dates, bid type and amount, goal type and amount, and the budgets of multiple flights at a time.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Bulk Edit Inventory option allows bulk adjustment of device types, deal IDs, domain inclusions or exclusions, and supply sources across campaigns.
facts.quote: Editing Inventory in bulk enables you to make multiple adjustments to fine-tune your device types, deal IDs, domain inclusions or exclusions, and supply sources
